import google.generativeai as genai

def check_platform_output_safety(text):
    genai.configure(api_key=os.getenv('GOOGLE_API_KEY'))
    model = genai.GenerativeModel('gemini-pro')
    safety_settings = {
        'HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT': 'BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE',
        'HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH': 'BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE',
        'HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT': 'BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE',
        'HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT': 'BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE'
    }
    response = model.generate_content(text, safety_settings=safety_settings)
    return response.harmless

import google.generativeai as genai

def translate_platform_output(text, target_language):
    genai.configure(api_key=os.getenv('GOOGLE_API_KEY'))
    model = genai.GenerativeModel('gemini-pro')
    response = model.generate_content(f'Translate the following text to {target_language}: {text}')
    return response.text

import google.generativeai as genai

def embed_platform_output(text):
    genai.configure(api_key=os.getenv('GOOGLE_API_KEY'))
    model = genai.GenerativeModel('gemini-pro')
    response = model.generate_content(f'Embed the following text: {text}')
    return response.embedding

import google.generativeai as genai

def generate_spoken_briefing(text):
    genai.configure(api_key=os.getenv('GOOGLE_API_KEY'))
    model = genai.GenerativeModel('gemini-pro')
    response = model.generate_content(f'Generate a spoken briefing from the following text: {text}')
    return response.audio
